name: Acid Coat
body:
School evocation [acid]; Level bloodrager 1, magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like the lesser acid coat spell except the damage dealt is 1d6/level (maximum 5d6) and the duration of the reduction is 1d4 rounds.
